title: Fix Storybook tests by providing SchemaRendererContext
body:
Storybook tests for `object-grid` and `page` components were failing because they used the local `SchemaRenderer` which doesn't provide context, but their child components (`ObjectGrid`, `data-table`) call `useDataScope()` → `useSchemaContext()`.

## Changes

**Updated imports in affected stories:**
```diff
- import { SchemaRenderer } from '../SchemaRenderer';
+ import { SchemaRenderer, SchemaRendererProvider } from '@object-ui/react';
```

**Wrapped renderers with provider:**
```diff
- render: (args) => <SchemaRenderer schema={args} />
+ render: (args) => (
+   <SchemaRendererProvider dataSource={{}}>
+     <SchemaRenderer schema={args} />
+   </SchemaRendererProvider>
+ )
```

**Files modified:**
- `packages/components/src/stories-json/object-grid.stories.tsx`
- `packages/components/src/stories-json/page.stories.tsx`

This follows the pattern already established in `packages/components/src/stories/MockedData.stories.tsx` and `CRMApp.stories.tsx`.
